flagged.title: Religious Experience, the Design Argument and the Cosmological Argument
flagged.reason: The video still attributes the evolutionary design argument to Cardinal Newman (F8), which is historically inaccurate and teaches students the wrong philosopher name for this argument.

mark_affecting.quote: they look to thinkers like Cardinal Newman. Newman basically said, hang on. The very fact that evolution follows predictable, orderly laws of physics is itself evidence of a lawgiver behind nature.
